# Draft:Battle of Hamadan (1726)

Date: 1726
Location: Hamadan, Iran
Result: Ottoman victory
Belligerents Ottoman Empire Hotak Dynasty Commanders Ottomans: Ahmet Pasha Hotakis: Ashraf Khan Background
The Hotak Dynasty defeated the Safavids in 1722 and took control of Iran. The Ottomans seized this opportunity and occupied some western Iranian territories. In 1726, the Ottoman army and Hotaki forces faced each other in Hamadan.
Battle

Results
The Ottomans captured some lands in western Iran. The Hotaki rule weakened and the Safavids retook Iran in 1729. The Ottomans and Safavids renewed the Treaty of Qasr-i-Shirin in 1732. Sources Uzunçarşılı, İsmail Hakkı. Ottoman History, Volume III. Turkish Historical Society, 1983. Floor, Willem. The Afghan Occupation of Safavid Persia 1722–1729. 2000.
